notes.title: iOS, Android and out of early access!
notes.notes:
Yo Reggae people! 

After over a year since it’s release to early access, we got enough feedback from you and now it’s time to make some progress.

Bolt Riley is now no longer in Early Access and the first chapter’s price was reduced to match a price of a chapter, and to better match the mobile versions price.


If you liked Bolt Riley - also check it out on mobile:
	iOS: http://bit.ly/BoltRileyIOS Android: http://bit.ly/BoltAndroid

Hope you enjoy!

Oded

notes.title: Bolt Riley is now available on Early Access!
notes.notes:
From our press release:
“Being funded through Kickstarter back in 2014, we’re launching the game with [i]high[/i] expectations,” said Oded Sharon, Adventure Mob’s CEO, “we are committed to our backers to deliver the game on time, so we pretty much have the date set in [i]stoned[/i], and we are working very hard to [i]weed[/i] out all the bugs. We’ve chosen this particular launch date, well... because we wanted everything in the game to be properly [i]baked[/i] and didn’t want our backers to get the munchies. Everything will be [i]lit up[/i] on time, and I expect players will be [i]lifted[/i] when playing it.”

Bolt Riley chapter 1 – is only the first installment in the story of Bolt Riley, and only the beginning of a longer story.

Check it, man!
